domain: Writes one screen-entry (tile index/flip bits, optionally OR'd with a palette-bank mask selected by a mode argument) into the UI window tilemap buffer at Data_03001e8c, at a single (x, y) cell offset by the window's own x/y fields and bounds-checked against the window's own width/height fields.
behavior: loads the shared tilemap base pointer *(u16 **)ADDR_03001E8C (Data_03001e8c, the same global every already-adopted ui/window and ui/text owner in this codebase dereferences)

rejects the call outright (no write) if y+1 is outside [0, window->height-1) or x+1 is outside [0, window->width-1), using the window's own u16 fields at offsets 0x8 (width) and 0xa (height), matching WINDOW_WIDTH/WINDOW_HEIGHT in games/gs1/src/ui/window/update_interpolated_geometry.c
computes a palette-bank mask from the mode argument: mode==3 -> 0xf000, mode==2 -> 0xe000, mode==4 -> 0x1000, any other value -> 0
mode==1 draws nothing at all (early return)

mode in [2,4] computes index = (window->y-field + y + 1) * 32 + (window->x-field + x + 1) using the window's u16 fields at offsets 0xc (x) and 0xe (y) -- the exact same field pair fill_tilemap_rect.c, set_tile_attribute_rect.c, and set_tile_attribute_bit_rect.c already use for the identical offset arithmetic -- bounds-checks it against 640 (32x20 cells), and stores mask|value as one halfword
mode==0 or mode>4 recomputes the identical index and, if in bounds, stores value alone (no mask OR'd in)

the only real caller found in this repository, games/gs1/src/unidentified/main/field/field_owner_108.c, always passes mode=0, so only the plain (no-OR) store path is exercised in practice; the mode 1-4 dispatch is evidenced solely by the retained assembly itself
